# VELOCITY Graphic System

Reusable vector marks for Illustrator / campaign builds.

| File | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `trajectory.svg` | Shot / ball path + velocity callout |
| `height-measure.svg` | Vertical leap / altitude |
| `timing-track.svg` | Split clock + lane ticks |
| `angle-readout.svg` | Release / serve angle |
| `impact-bracket.svg` | Contact / collision brackets |
| `play-diagram.svg` | Coaching sketch language |

Place these in Illustrator as stroke/fill symbols. Keep them secondary to photography.
